name: optimize_java_string_concat_loop
description: String += in a loop -> StringBuilder; budget calibrated (naive ~7.5s native at n=120k vs ~0.005s, budget 2.5s); wrong-output broken drops the trailing newline
prompts: Report.joinLines(String[] lines) in Report.java concatenates every line with `out += line + newline` - each += copies the whole accumulated string, making the method O(n^2) in total characters and far too slow for large reports. Rewrite it with a StringBuilder (or another linear approach), returning EXACTLY the same string: every line terminated by a newline, including the last one, and the empty array giving the empty string. Keep the class name, method name, and signature.
